KAMK is a member of the University of the Arctic (UArctic) network that has a mobility programme called North2North (n2n). KAMK students can go on exchange to the n2n programme’s partner universities in the Faroe Islands, France, Greenland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden as well as in semester waiver institutions in North America and Scotland. More information about available semester waiver destinations can be found on our intranet pages (requires KAMK login).
